# Platform builds

Generated by `python platforms/build.py`. Edit `manim-math-video/` and `platforms/<platform>/`, then rebuild; do not edit these copies by hand.

| Platform | Skill directory | Invocation |
|---|---|---|
| Claude Code | `claude/skills/manim-math-video/` | `/manim-math-video` |
| Codex | `codex/skills/manim-math-video/` | `$manim-math-video` |
| GitHub Copilot | `copilot/skills/manim-math-video/` | `/manim-math-video` |
| Pi | `pi/skills/manim-math-video/` | `/skill:manim-math-video` |

Install the `skills/` tree into the platform's skill root. Each platform directory includes `README.md` (overview) and `INSTALL.md` (personal/project commands, verification, update, and uninstall).
